verdict.rationale: Live probes show Deel serves an llms.txt at developer.deel.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200). Its docs also offer clean Markdown for any page by appending .md, plus a complete documentation index, and many cited docs pages are themselves served as .md URLs. That is agent-oriented documentation an agent can be pointed at directly. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs, and the llms.txt appears to contain stray HTML (a stylesheet link tag), suggesting it is not fully cleaned for agents.
